Rockwell Instrument Company

Rockwell Instrument Company manufactures precision pressure gauges for industrial process control. Every gauge is calibrated against a reference standard traceable to national metrology institutes, and ships with the calibration certificate for that individual unit.

The company has built pressure instrumentation in Sheffield since 1948. Its gauges are used in chemical processing, hydraulics testing and steam plant, where a reading that drifts by two percent is the difference between a passing inspection and a failed one.

Calibration and traceability

Each instrument is compared against a deadweight tester at five points across its range, both rising and falling, so hysteresis is recorded rather than averaged away. The certificate states the measured error at every point instead of a single headline accuracy figure.

Ordering

Gauges are made to order against a specified range and connection thread. Lead time is four weeks for standard ranges and eight weeks where a non-standard dial is required.
